description: Lists the selectable options (size, color, pack) for an offer whose has_options=true, with one variant per combination. Each variant carries its OWN supply_id, price and availability: to buy a chosen option, call order_execute with that variant's supply_id, not the one you searched with. Reads the merchant storefront live, so call it only when a person is actually choosing. Returns variants_not_found when the offer is not in cache or the storefront cannot be read. A single-variant product returns options:[] variants:[].

agent_id.description: Agent id, for permission and analytics

session_token.description: Session token from agent_authenticate — required whenever agent_id is passed

supply_id.description: Offer supply id whose product options to list (has_options=true on the offer)

name: supply_options
title: List product options
